reason: Adapter validation found one source-native Torre date with visitor observations but all census time values missing. Because effort is defined as the number of unique 15-minute locality x date x time x plant censuses, that date cannot be normalized under the frozen effort contract.

admission_effect: Torre remains admitted because 13 effort-normalizable source-native dates remain, exceeding the frozen six-bin floor, and 16 nonconstant partner series remain, exceeding the three-series floor.
claim_boundary: This is a missing-effort correction made before natural coordinate computation. It is not a coordinate- or route-informed time-bin selection.
